title: AI政治团体斥资数亿介入中期选举
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: There's always a lot on the minds of voters, and this critical midterm is no exception.
segments.zh: 选民们总是关心很多议题，这次关键的中期选举也不例外。

segments.en: But one issue is cutting across party lines, touching upon the economy, environment, and possibly the future of humanity.
segments.zh: 但有一个议题跨越党派界限，涉及经济、环境，甚至可能影响人类未来。

segments.en: All we've heard about is how big AI will be. Growing in the United States at least for now is this mimbyism and this pushback to data centers getting constructed.
segments.zh: 我们听到的都是AI将有多大规模。至少目前在美国，增长的是这种邻避情绪和对数据中心建设的抵制。

segments.en: Pull after pull after pull shows that there's a lot of anxiety among the general population about AI and what it's going to mean for their futures, fear of job loss, fear of a loss
segments.zh: 一次又一次的民调显示，普通民众对AI及其对未来意味着什么充满焦虑，担心失业，担心失去
